EIS 2026 Variable Atlas

Every substantive variable in the BPC Election Information Survey, 2026 field, weighted.

3,144 registered voters, weighted by the delivered Morning Consult weight (see 'eis_2026_06_design_data.R' for why this weight rather than a raked one). Bars show a weighted percentage with a 95% confidence interval (survey::svyciprop / svymean). A branching item's caption states its base condition and the respondent count within that base. Generated by eis_2026_07_plots_overview.R on September 18, 2026.
